title: School board reviews allegation involving youth program

verified_facts.text: The Northbank School Board opened an independent review of the after-school grant program on 4 September 2026.
A complaint alleges that attendance totals were overstated; the allegation has not been substantiated.
No student is accused of wrongdoing.
The board expects an initial report in October.
